name: Mahoutsukai no ♀ Deshi
source:
Cute magician apprentice Lefuur commonly called as Fu Fu is the main heroine of the game. She is in love with her mentor wizard Klimt and will go any lengths to fulfill his difficult requests. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
可爱的魔法师学徒露芙露芙是本作女主角，大家通常叫她“芙芙”。她爱慕导师克里姆特，为完成他提出的艰难要求，无论什么都愿意去做。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
